rule: This file is a TASK PLAN, not a log. Completed work and history live in git log and docs/HONEST_NEGATIVE_CATALOG.md; nothing finished stays here. Every task has a numeric done_when. Nothing is marked DONE without an artifact path.
scope: CFM / generative line only. Predictive line: docs/PREDICTIVE_LINE_INDEX.md. Results: docs/CFM_RESULTS.md.
principle: Do not iterate the model blindly. Gate each module on its own function, then gate the seams between modules. A module that cannot pass its own gate is a bug to fix, not a result to report. Fix order is by measured severity, not by convenience.

module_gates.check: For every training batch: x_t == (1-t)*x0 + t*x1 elementwise, v_target == x1 - x0, and x0's per-atom std matches flow.fm_noise_sigma.
module_gates.measured: identity residual 5.96e-07, both boundaries exact, sigma measured 2.525 against 2.485 declared (1.6%)

module_gates.check: Hold a fixed batch, perturb ONE conditioning input at a time, measure the relative change in the velocity output: swap the metal atom's identity, shift t by 0.25, swap an atom type.
module_gates.pass: each of the three produces ||dv|| / ||v|| > 1e-2. A conditioning channel that moves the output by 0 is not connected.
module_gates.measured: on c8 (radial, epoch 2): metal swap 0.74%, t shift 86%, atom-type swap 17.5%. Metal identity is the weakest input channel in the model by two orders of magnitude.
module_gates.fix: flow.metal_conditioning=embedding (Wf-A108j) takes the response to 65.8% on the same checkpoint. Needs a trained fixed arm to be judged under the same protocol.

module_gates.check: One fixed batch, 2,000 optimizer steps, no regularisers. Measure train MSE against the v=0 baseline (mean-squared target norm) for velocity_head in {radial, vector_channels}.
module_gates.pass: train MSE <= 10% of the v=0 baseline for the head we ship
module_gates.measured: vector_channels: 0.0885 against a v=0 baseline of 11.7605, i.e. 0.75% of baseline and 1.4% of the radial ceiling 6.3179. radial on c8: 98.9% of baseline, CANNOT_FIT.

module_gates.check: At several t, report ||v_pred|| / ||v_target|| against the magnitude the interpolant can actually support, bayes_ratio(t) = |E[x1-x0|x_t]| / |x1-x0|, measured by Monte Carlo from the batch.
module_gates.pass: ratio in [0.5, 2.0] x bayes_ratio(t), lower bound applied only where bayes_ratio >= 0.15
module_gates.measured: 5-epoch vector_channels: ratio 0.0211..0.0246 across t against bayes_ratio 0.6967 at t=0.05, 0.0721 at t=0.5, 0.6371 at t=0.95, i.e. the field emits 3-6% of what is achievable at the ends.
module_gates.why: The old band was a fixed [0.5, 2.0] on the raw ratio, which at t=0.5 demands ten times the achievable magnitude. The band is now relative to bayes_ratio (Wf-A108j).

module_gates.check: One backward from fm_term alone; per-parameter-block grad norm, and the name of every parameter in a judged block that receives no gradient.
module_gates.pass: every block in _FM_REACH_BLOCKS has a non-zero grad norm, and no judged block is more than 100x another's
module_gates.measured: vel_field 5.1293 with 54 of 62 parameters receiving gradient; the 8 that do not are atom_head, pocket_residue_embed and the 6 cross_attn tensors, none of which the FM path uses. head and pocket_encoder are reported at 0 and not judged: bond_ce trains the first and no config supplies pocket features.

module_gates.check: Fix x and z, sweep t over 101 points in [0,1], record the velocity.
module_gates.pass: the output changes by more than 10% of its own norm across the sweep, smoothly. A field flat in t cannot represent a flow.
module_gates.measured: 5-epoch vector_channels: endpoint change 2.31% of the norm (smoothness 2.17e-06, so it is flat, not jumpy). c8 radial: 198.5%.
module_gates.fix: vc_head.t_gate (Wf-A108j) writes a t-dependence at init through the LSQ fit at 9 knots. Needs a trained fixed arm.

module_gates.check: List which parameters tmQM pretraining does NOT transfer.
module_gates.pass: no missing key may be an atom embedding, a time MLP, or a velocity head; those must be listed explicitly if they are
module_gates.measured: 47 of 51 transfer. The 4 that do not are cross_attn.in_proj_weight and layers.{0,1,2}.update_mlp.linear1.weight, all named in the artifact. None is an atom embedding, a time MLP or a velocity head.

module_gates.check: Run the trainer's velocity call and the ODE sampler's velocity call on the same (x, t, z, cloud_sizes); compare bit-exactly.
From loss_terms, each weighted term's share of the total, per epoch; and whether every term that contributes has a declared weight.
module_gates.pass: no single term above 90% of the total, and no contributing term without a declared weight
module_gates.measured: worst term fm_term at 88.6% of the total. The previous criterion also required every declared weight to be observable, which is not decidable from the artifact; that list is now reported instead of judged.
module_gates.why: A weight of 0.05 whose feature is off exports an exact zero term and is indistinguishable from a dead knob. The decidable half is the reverse direction.

module_gates.check: Every reported generation metric names the checkpoint hash, the split fingerprint and the sampler settings; the checkpoint on disk is the one the run wrote.
module_gates.pass: hash + split fingerprint match, and the checkpoint exists at the path the artifact names
module_gates.measured: fails on the 5-epoch artifact because it predates the provenance block. Passes on any run written after Wf-A108j: the smoke's per_epoch_metrics.json carries checkpoint path, sha256, both split fingerprints and the sampler block.
module_gates.fix: trainer-side, not gate-side. Re-measured PASS on the Wf-A108j smoke.

tasks.what: Flip M2, M4 and M6 to PASS on a trained arm with the fixes on. The fixes themselves are in and config-keyed (flow.vector_channel_norm_gain, flow.velocity_head_init, flow.t_embedding_dim, flow.metal_conditioning, flow.fm_t_dist); configs/wfa108j_fixed_cpu_2026_10_25.yaml is the arm.
tasks.done_when: all three gates PASS on a checkpoint written by that config, under the same protocol as the failing measurement
tasks.blocked_by: nothing, after the memory workaround. MEASURED 2026-10-25: both launches of this config reached anon-rss 35.79 GB (pid 2513370, 13:54:34) and 42.52 GB (pid 2581802, 15:52:07) and were killed by the kernel; both were global OOMs that took an unrelated tmux session with them. One variable explains it — FmOdeTerm at weight 0.05 runs 16 extra velocity-field forwards per step and holds every graph until backward: with it on, RSS went 1.1 -> 8.0 GB in 26 s with no reclaim; with fm_ode_term_weight 0.0, peak 5.28 GB and a bounded 2.1 <-> 4.6 GB sawtooth. The term contributes 0.159 of a 29.72 train_loss, so it is off in the arm (see the config comment) and the arm now runs under an 8 GB RSS ceiling. The retention itself is F3.
tasks.note: M10 does not need this: it passes on any artifact written after the provenance block, verified on the smoke. Correction to an earlier version of this file: the 13:54 victim was this arm, not another session's process.

tasks.what: Re-run the 125-step regime arm with the fixes on, against the Wf-A108h baseline (fm_term 12.260 -> 12.237, field 8.928 vs v=0 9.008).
tasks.done_when: fm_term falls by more than 10% in 125 steps, or the arm is a measured no-op with the gate numbers that explain why

tasks.what: FmOdeTerm turns a bounded per-step allocation into unbounded growth. It runs 4 RK4 steps x 4 forwards = 16 extra velocity-field forwards per training step and keeps all of their graphs until backward. With it on, RSS on a 64-cloud arm went 1.1 -> 8.0 GB in 26 s with no reclaim and the full run reached 42.52 GB; with fm_ode_term_weight 0.0 the same arm peaks at 5.28 GB and oscillates 2.1 <-> 4.6 GB. 16 graphs is bounded, so the retention must be across steps, not within one.
tasks.done_when: the arm runs 2 epochs at fm_ode_term_weight 0.05 under an 8 GB RSS ceiling without the watchdog firing, and the growth curve is written to an artifact

tasks.what: Full-corpus run with the fixed model: batch 64, 18 epochs, same split as c7.
tasks.done_when: checkpoint on disk + per-epoch metrics + generation pool, and the field beats v=0 by a margin that survives a seed repeat

tasks.done_when: per-seed numbers with a paired test, not a 5-point bootstrap
